note.question: How does grocery-store density affect the food waste generated at stores and by households?
note.overview: This paper studies the impact of grocery-store density on the food waste generated at stores and by households. Food waste is a major contributor to carbon emissions (as big as road transport). Identifying and influencing market conditions that can decrease food waste is thus important to combat global warming.
